ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What organ does food pass through between label F and label I?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of the human digestive system. Label F is located near the head and neck, pointing to the mouth/pharynx region; label I is located on the right side of the abdomen, pointing to the stomach. In the figure, what connects downward from the pharynx to the stomach is a long vertical tubular structure. Reasoning: Before food goes downward from the mouth/pharynx region to reach the stomach, it passes through this tube connecting the pharynx and the stomach. According to the order of the digestive tract, the organ after the mouth/pharynx and before the stomach is the esophagus.
